# Phase 3 final test results (generated by scripts/final_test_report.py)

Test windows identical to those of the original MinMax setup and of the Phase 2 baselines. Neural models and ensembles: mean ± std over seeds 1–3 (sample std). MASE = MAE / MAE(persistence) on the same windows (< 1 beats persistence). DM = Diebold–Mariano vs persistence, HLN small-sample correction, Newey–West variance with lag h − 1, two-sided p for seeds 1/2/3. Verdict: "beats" or "worse" only if the sign agrees and p < 0.05 in all three seeds; Holm = the same after Holm adjustment over all seed-level neural/ensemble tests of that loss.

Conditions: `minmax` = MinMax scaling fitted on the training rows (the original setup); `selected` = each model's validation-selected transform (results/selection/selection.json).

## Where a model significantly beats persistence on test

- **None.** No neural model or ensemble beats persistence with p < 0.05 in all three seeds, for either loss.
